website.headline: It starts from what you already have.

learned.headline: What it knows, and how it will sound.
learned.lead: Approve once. Everything here lands in Knowledge, where you can change it any time.
learned.foot: Nothing reaches a customer until you say so
learned.title: What GOTCHA knows now
learned.count: {facts, plural, =1 {1 topic from your website} other {# topics from your website}}
learned.countFromPages: {facts, plural, =1 {1 topic} other {# topics}} from {pages, plural, =1 {1 page} other {# pages}}

voice.title: How you sound
voice.unread: Couldn't read the voice just now.

voice.sampleNeedsVoice: Describe the voice first, then ask for a reply

truth.headline: The most important connection you'll make.
truth.lead: Your website explains how things work. Your store knows what's true right now. GOTCHA checks it before every answer about an order, a price or stock.
truth.foot: You decide what it may change. Reading is always safe
truth.title: Where does the truth live?
truth.subtitle: Orders, stock, prices and customers. GOTCHA checks here before every answer, so it never guesses from an old web page

how.woocommerce: Your store's address, then approve in WooCommerce
how.google_sheets: A sheet you share with GOTCHA

truth.unread: Couldn't read your systems just now. Try again in a moment.
truth.comesBack: Connecting opens {name}. When it's done you come back to Studio · Integrations, where the connection shows.

may.title: What GOTCHA may do there

actions.cancel: Cancel an order that hasn't shipped

may.why: You set these in Studio · Integrations once the workspace is live. They can't be set during setup yet

truth.skipWhy: Without it, GOTCHA can explain your policies, but it can't check an order, a price or stock
truth.failingWhy: {name} stopped letting GOTCHA in. Reconnect to sign in again.

try.headline: Judge it on your own questions.
try.lead: Things customers asked that GOTCHA couldn't answer yet. Teach each one once, and every employee knows it
try.foot: Setup mode: it only talks to your team until you go live
try.title: Your real questions
try.leadNone: Once customers write, what GOTCHA can't answer yet shows up here and on Home, to teach once
try.unread: Couldn't read your customers' questions just now
try.answersWhy: Trying GOTCHA's answers needs a live workspace: the test chat opens after you go live. Until then, teach the answers it's missing
try.placeholder: The answer, the way you'd give it to a customer
try.learned: Learned. It's in Knowledge now, for every employee
try.failed: It wasn't learned. Try again in a moment
try.nextOnHome: Next on Home: connect WhatsApp and invite your team
try.finishing: Opening your workspace and hiring your AI employee…

noKnowledge.title: Your workspace is open, but GOTCHA has nothing to answer from yet
noKnowledge.lead: Nothing in Knowledge is ready to use: the website read added nothing it can answer from. Until you add some, your AI employee will hand most questions to your team.

refused.core_system_required: Finishing needs your main business system connected (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Fireberry, Airtable or Shopify), or skipped on the previous step.
refused.needs_profile: Finishing needs your business's name and a short description, and the website read didn't find them.
refused.refused: It couldn't finish yet. Try again in a moment, or ask GOTCHA's team.
refused.failed: It didn't finish. Try again in a moment.
